title: Degenerations of Jordan algebras
summary: We describe all degenerations of complex $4$-dimensional Jordan algebras and of complex $5$-dimensional nilpotent Jordan algebras. The proofs do not use other papers on degenerations, and all degenerations and non-degenerations were formally verified in the proof assistant Lean~4. The graph of primary degenerations of $4$-dimensional Jordan algebras has $73$ vertices and $160$ edges.
